name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardMissionContinueActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user pauses or returns to an unfinished experience-reward task. It asks whether to continue the task or give up its pending reward.
disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to resume this ad-reward task or claim its pending reward.
